url.label: WAIP server URL
url.help: Base URL of the WAIP dispatch server (Socket.IO endpoint, namespace /waip is appended automatically)

monitorID.label: Monitor ID
monitorID.help: Loaded live from the configured server's /waip/ overview page - choose by Leitstelle, Kreis, Träger or Wache, or pick 'Alle Wachalarme' (ID 0) for every incident. If the server can't be reached, an ID can still be entered manually.

registrationTimeoutSec.label: Registration timeout (s)
registrationTimeoutSec.help: How long to wait for the server to confirm the monitor registration before logging a warning; the connection itself keeps running either way.

reconnectDelaySec.label: Reconnect delay (s)
reconnectDelaySec.help: Wait time before the adapter automatically reconnects after a lost connection or a connection error.

rdKeywordDecodingEnabled.label: Automatically decode rescue-service keywords (R<RTW>N<NEF>[p][f][-NT])
rdKeywordDecodingEnabled.help: Rescue-service keyword scheme (R<RTW>N<NEF>[p][f][-NT], e.g. "R1N0" = 1 ambulance, no emergency physician) used by several German dispatch centers (documented example: Leitstelle Lausitz) - only enable if your dispatch center actually uses this pattern. Takes priority over the table below when a keyword matches.

rdLabelR.label: Label for R (ambulance count)
rdLabelR.help: Text used in the generated description for the R<n> part, e.g. "Rettungswagen: 1".

rdLabelN.label: Label for N (emergency vehicle count)
rdLabelN.help: Text used in the generated description for the N<n> part, e.g. "Notfalleinsatzfahrzeug: 0".

rdLabelP.label: Label for suffix p (polytrauma)
rdLabelP.help: Text appended when the keyword ends in "p".

rdLabelF.label: Label for suffix f (first responder)
rdLabelF.help: Text appended when the keyword ends in "f".

rdLabelNT.label: Label for suffix -NT (special ambulance transport)
rdLabelNT.help: Text appended when the keyword ends in "-NT".

stichwortMapping.label: Alarm keyword descriptions
stichwortMapping.help: Maps einsatz.stichwort to einsatz.beschreibung. If several rows match, the most specific (longest) pattern wins automatically - row order has no effect on matching, sort by keyword freely. Pre-filled with an example fire/rescue keyword list as a starting point - it is not confirmed to match your own dispatch center's actual keywords, edit/replace as needed. Export/import as CSV via the buttons above the table.
